title: Eight Sites Tres Idiomas
style: trilingual cinematic indie folk anthem, male lead vocal NZ AU lean, acoustic guitar, soft cello, brushed drums, warm bass, gentle choir on chorus, three-language verse handoff, hopeful steady, 94 bpm
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Eight sites breathing, eight brothers near
The signal is steady, the line is clear
Three three six humming all night long
The stack is alive, the stack is strong

[Verse 2 — Español]
Ocho sitios respiran, ocho hermanos cerca
La señal es firme, la línea no se acerca
Tres tres seis suena toda la noche
La torre está viva, sin ningún reproche

[Verse 3 — 中文]
Bā gè zhàn diǎn, bā gè xiōng dì
Xiùn hào wěn, xiàn lù qīng xī
Sān sān liù zhěng yè chàng
Tǔ jià huó, tǔ jià qiáng

[Chorus — Tres Idiomas]
Eight sites, ocho sitios, bā gè zhàn
One family, una familia, yí gè jiā
Three three six, tres tres seis, sān sān liù
We stand together, juntos firmes, wǒ men yī qǐ

[Bridge]
No site is alone, ningún sitio está solo, méi yǒu gū dān
The brothers breathe as one
Los hermanos respiran como uno
Xiōng dì men yī qǐ hū xī

[Outro]
Eight sites forever, ocho sitios para siempre, bā gè zhàn yǒng yuǎn
Three three six, tres tres seis, sān sān liù
